jobs.title: Loading Dock Attendant (M-F 7am-4pm)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

This role is crucial for ensuring the smooth operation of residential moves and maintaining the overall upkeep of our property. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating the arrival and departure of moving trucks, scheduling and monitoring on-site movers, and protecting property during deliveries and moves. Additional responsibilities include managing bulk material pickups, conducting daily residential garage inspections, and ensuring building security through routine FOB checks. The Loading Dock Attendant will also liaise with vendors for routine cleaning schedules, report incidents to the property manager, and submit maintenance tickets for timely resolution. Flexibility to assist with various tasks as assigned by the property manager and the engineering & operations team is essential.  #weshowup

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Coordinate the arrival and departure of moving trucks 
  • Coordinate residential move in and move outs, to include scheduling and monitoring on site movers
  • Protect doors and floors during deliveries and moves
  • Coordinate pickups and removal of bulk material items from loading dock and trash room areas
  • Report incidents or accidents to property manager as needed 
  • Complete daily Residential garage inspections and provide inspection report to manager
  • Manage routine cleaning schedules by vendor

jobs.title: Manager, Alumni Engagement & Operations
jobs.description_text:
About the Company

Correlation One is the largest provider of AI and data workforce development programs globally, having trained over 500,000 professionals across 11 countries. As the largest training provider for Amazon Career Choice, and a growing partner to state governments building registered apprenticeship programs, Correlation One sits at the intersection of employer talent needs and scalable workforce training.

We work with Fortune 500 enterprises, federal and state government agencies, and leading employers to close skills gaps in AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, and operations leadership. Our programs produce job-ready graduates who are prepared to contribute from day one.

About the Role

Graduates of our Amazon Career Choice programs receive up to 18 months of post-program support: career coaching, an alumni community of roughly 9,000 members, and connections to employer partners. This role owns the systems that make that support work. That includes how alumni hear from us, how they move through our community, how coaches are deployed, and how outcomes data moves from our warehouse into decisions. The role is part communicator, part builder, part analyst, with AI built into how you do all three. It suits someone who writes a warm launch post in the morning and debugs an Apps Script trigger in the afternoon.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Regional Research Economist at Anthropic, you will collaborate with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region to measure and understand AI’s effects on the economy and explore research-driven policy interventions. You will contribute to the development of the Anthropic Economic Index and its extension to generate regionally relevant insights, establish new methodologies to measure the usage, diffusion, and impact of AI throughout the economy, and work to broaden access to and usage of the insights generated by the Index. jobs.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobs.description_text:
Figure is an AI robotics company developing autonomous general-purpose humanoid robots. The goal of the company is to ship humanoid robots with human level intelligence. Its robots are engineered to perform a variety of tasks in the home and commercial markets. Figure is headquartered in San Jose, CA.

We are looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist. This role will support our Accounting team and manage our AP processes and systems from end to end.

Responsibilities:

Fortera is transforming one of the world’s largest industries by reinventing how cement is made. このポジションは、技術とビジネスの両面を兼ね備えたハイブリッドな役割です。担当するお客様とユースケースにおいて、成長を推進します。ビジネス面では、お客様の意思決定者と関係を構築し、他の専門チームと連携しながら、Databricksが実行できる計画や戦略を策定・推進します。技術面ではDatabricksの全製品における、お客様導入後の技術的なリーダーとなります。組織内のあらゆるレベルの人々と、技術的な専門知識を活かしてコミュニケーションをとる能力が求められます。

  • プラットフォームの成熟度とスケーリングのニーズを予測し、セキュリティ、ガバナンス、運用の卓越性に関するベストプラクティスを確立する。
  • アーキテクチャに影響を与え、デリバリーの障害を取り除き、技術的な実行をビジネス成果に結びつけることで、プラットフォームの採用と利用を促進する。
  • Databricks、お客様、導入チームと連携し、リソースの調整、リスク管理、デリバリーの加速を行う。
  • 同僚を指導し、組織全体で活用できる再利用可能な技術ガイダンス、フレームワーク、およびイネーブルメントに貢献する。

While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale. 

Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.
